name: Otohime Raimu
source:
A gyaru-type girl with a bright and friendly personality on the outside. Her true nature is very emotional which is shown by acting shy to her favorite person but becoming abusive otherwise. Because of her wealthy parents' influence, she always acts arrogant toward main character. Somehow, she is interested in Kimiko the outcast.

[spoiler]She is the mastermind in trapping the main character in order to threaten him only to get blackmailed instead.[/spoiler]
